recipe.variant: 3B Int8 (3.46 GB): the official template file for both image and video; docs: 'lower VRAM'; scale 2; latent split into VRAM-sized temporal chunks (SeedVR2TemporalChunk auto -> KSampler once per chunk -> SeedVR2TemporalMerge): the long-clip / OOM route
recipe.from_template: utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_video (subgraph 'Upscale Video (SeedVR2 3B Int8)' flattened; the trim_video switch resolved OFF so 'Video Slice' is elided - trim upstream; the split_latent switch resolved ON: SeedVR2TemporalChunk -> KSampler -> SeedVR2TemporalMerge wired as the template's on_true branch). Template resize node is ResizeImageMaskNode ('scale by multiplier', lanczos). Written here as ImageScaleBy (lanczos, scale_by): the same lanczos resample of the IMAGE (RGBA passes through), because the offline validator cannot type ResizeImageMaskNode's COMFY_MATCHTYPE_V3 socket. Swap back on the box if the v3 node is preferred.

scale.note: upscale factor; the DiT restores at the resolution it is handed (template default 4 for stills, 2 for video). VRAM and time scale with output megapixels x frames

seed.note: one-step models still consume noise: the seed changes micro-detail

denoise.note: 1.0 = full restore (template); lower values are exposed by the template but undocumented

sampler_name.note: euler (template); no official guidance beyond the default

color_correction_method.note: none (template) | lab (node default, 'most faithful', most memory) | wavelet | adain

unet_name.note: swap precision/size here: see profile.files (same graph for every seedvr2_* file)

temporal_size.note: frames the VAE encodes/decodes at a time (template 64 for video, 4096 for stills)

chunk_overlap.note: latent frames shared between chunks and Hann-crossfaded at merge; template 0 = hard cut; clamped to chunk_latent-1

chunking_mode.note: auto (template: 'predict the largest chunk that fits free VRAM' with the official law) | manual with 'chunking_mode.frames_per_chunk' (4n+1, default 21)

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, dpmpp_2m, res_multistep, …)

video.note: the clip to restore/upscale; frames, audio, fps and bit_depth are read by GetVideoComponents and audio/fps/bit_depth pass through to CreateVideo unchanged. The frame count is padded to 4n+1 by SeedVR2Preprocess and cropped back by SeedVR2PostProcessing.

recipe.defaults_note: scale 2 (template default for video); 1 step / cfg 1 / euler / simple / denoise 1; VAE tiling 512/128, temporal 64/8; color correction none; source fps, audio and bit depth preserved (linked from GetVideoComponents, never literals). Chunking auto sizes chunks from free VRAM with the official law (0.55 GiB per latent frame per Mpx, 8.5 GiB reserved, 4x0.55 GiB sigma margin); chunk temporal_overlap 0 (template).

vram_evidence.gpu: RTX 5090 (official 17-cell resolution sweep + T bisection, 3B fp16)
vram_evidence.usage: max_latent_frames = (free_GiB - 8.5 - 4*0.55) / (0.55 * output_megapixels); pixel frames = 4*latent_frames - 3. Example (3B fp16, RTX 5090): 1920x1080 output = 2.07 Mpx -> 1.14 GiB per latent frame; 24 GiB free -> ~11 latent frames ~ 41 pixel frames per chunk
